newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Four German tourists die in S.Africa road accident.
newsitem.headline: Four German tourists die in S.Africa road accident.

text.p: Four German tourists were killed in a road accident on Tuesday in South Africa's Mpumalanga region, home to the country's premier game parks.
A police spokesman said the accident occurred when one wheel broke on the minibus the tourists were travelling in.
"We don't know how that happened but the driver lost control and the vehicle overturned. Four passengers from Germany died in the accident," he told Reuters.
Police had notified the German consultate, which would attempt to trace the tourists' families, he said. He added police were unable to release any other details.
The accident took place on a national highway at 0650 GMT. The driver was in serious condition in hospital while another passenger was discharged after being treated for light injuries.
